packageIdentity.description: Versionless package identity used by Agent bindings to reference already-declared dependencies.

name.description: Generation-time scaffold variable name. Use only for non-secret template values.

description.description: Describe how the scaffold value is used. Do not use template variables for API keys, tokens, passwords, or runtime secrets.

memoryKey.description: Stable identifier used for Memory Blueprint scopes, record types, spaces, and operations.

memoryGovernanceDataClass.description: Supported AgentPM governance classification value for x-agentpm-data-class annotations in Memory content schemas.

memoryGovernanceSensitivity.description: Supported AgentPM sensitivity value for x-agentpm-sensitivity annotations in Memory content schemas.

x-agentpm-persist.description: Supported AgentPM governance flag for marking values as non-persistable durable memory.

x-agentpm-shareable.description: Supported AgentPM governance flag for restricting cross-boundary sharing.

memoryGovernanceAnnotations.description: Supported AgentPM-owned governance annotation names and value types for Memory content schemas.

description.description: Required human-readable description of the logical scope key.

memoryScopes.description: Author-declared reusable scope keys for the Memory Blueprint.

version.description: Required semantic version for the authored record content schema.

description.description: Required human-readable description of the record type.

schema.description: Required safe package-relative path to the Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for the record content payload.

memoryRecordTypes.description: Author-declared record type contracts for the Memory Blueprint.

memoryRetrievalMode.description: Supported logical retrieval mode for a Memory space.

modes.description: Required unique set of logical retrieval capabilities that a compatible runtime must support.

max_records.description: Optional declarative maximum record count for the space.

ttl.description: Required ISO 8601 duration string describing how long active records should remain available.

on_expire.description: Required declarative behavior for expired records.

append_only.description: Optional declarative constraint indicating that new records are appended rather than updated in place.

description.description: Required human-readable description of the logical memory space.

model.description: Required logical storage model for the space.

record_types.description: Required unique list of record types permitted in the space.

scope.description: Required ordered scope keys that define the logical identity of records in the space.

retrieval.description: Required logical retrieval capabilities for the space.

capacity.description: Optional declarative capacity metadata for the space.

retention.description: Optional declarative retention metadata for the space.

constraints.description: Optional declarative constraints for the space.

memorySpaces.description: Author-declared logical spaces in the Memory Blueprint.

space.description: Declared space key referenced by the operation.

record_type.description: Declared record type key referenced by the operation.

space.description: Declared target space key referenced by a delete operation.

type.description: Operation is invoked by an external application, future binding, or harness.
Operation becomes eligible when a space reaches a record threshold.

space.description: Declared space key monitored by the trigger.

type.description: Operation becomes eligible when a space reaches its declared capacity.

space.description: Declared space key monitored by the trigger.

type.description: Operation becomes eligible on a recurring elapsed-time interval.

every.description: Required ISO 8601 duration string for the recurring interval.

memorySourceHandling.description: Supported declarative source-handling policy for lifecycle operations.

type.description: Operation converts one or more source records into a destination record.

description.description: Required human-readable description of the operation.

trigger.description: Required declarative trigger for the operation.

source_handling.description: Required declarative policy for source records after successful completion.

preserve_provenance.description: Required flag indicating whether derived records should retain source provenance.

type.description: Operation converts one source record contract into another record contract.

description.description: Required human-readable description of the operation.

trigger.description: Required declarative trigger for the operation.

source_handling.description: Required declarative policy for source records after successful completion.

preserve_provenance.description: Required flag indicating whether derived records should retain source provenance.

type.description: Operation declares a set of spaces that may be deleted as one lifecycle action.

description.description: Required human-readable description of the operation.

trigger.description: Required declarative trigger for the operation.

targets.description: Required unique set of target spaces affected by the delete operation.

cascade_derived_records.description: Required flag indicating whether derived records should also be removed.

memoryOperation.description: Supported declarative lifecycle operation contract for a Memory Blueprint.

memoryOperations.description: Optional declarative lifecycle operations for the Memory Blueprint.

scopes.description: Required reusable scope declarations for the Memory Blueprint.

record_types.description: Required record type declarations for the Memory Blueprint.

spaces.description: Required logical spaces declared by the Memory Blueprint.

operations.description: Optional declarative lifecycle operations for the Memory Blueprint.

skillCompatibility.description: Descriptive compatibility metadata for a Skill. These values are informational and not runtime-enforced.

model_families.description: Optional open-ended model family labels the Skill was authored or reviewed against.

runtimes.description: Optional known runtimes or execution surfaces this Skill is intended to work well with.

environments.description: Optional open-ended operating system, shell, or workspace environment labels assumed by the Skill.

skillMetadata.description: Skill-specific metadata describing the primary authored instructions and any supporting files packaged with the Skill.

entrypoint.description: Required relative path to the main Skill instructions file, typically SKILL.md.

references.description: Optional additional authored reference files that support the Skill instructions.

scripts.description: Optional helper scripts packaged with the Skill for local execution or demonstration.

compatibility.description: Optional descriptive compatibility hints for models, runtimes, environments, or export targets.

path.description: Required relative path to a packaged document intended for direct context loading.

content_type.description: Optional MIME type or content classification for the document.

role.description: Optional role label describing how the document should be used, such as context or reference.

description.description: Optional human-readable note about the purpose of the document.

bytes.description: Optional build-derived byte size of the declared document.

sha256.description: Optional build-derived content hash for the declared document.

document_count.description: Optional build-derived count of declared context documents.

total_bytes.description: Optional build-derived total byte size across declared context documents.

content_hash.description: Optional build-derived aggregate content hash for the context corpus.

chunks_path.description: Relative path to the packaged chunks JSONL file for vector-mode Knowledge.

sources_path.description: Relative path to the packaged sources JSONL file for vector-mode Knowledge.

chunk_count.description: Optional build-derived count of chunks in the vector corpus.

source_count.description: Optional build-derived count of unique sources in the vector corpus.

content_hash.description: Optional build-derived aggregate content hash for the chunks and sources payload.

strategy.description: Optional open-ended label describing the chunking strategy used to prepare the corpus.

chunk_size.description: Optional chunk size used during corpus preparation.

overlap.description: Optional overlap size used during corpus preparation.

id.description: Required embedding payload identifier, used to associate vectors and indexes.

provider.description: Required embedding provider label recorded for provenance and compatibility.

model.description: Required embedding model label recorded for provenance and compatibility.

dimensions.description: Required vector dimensionality for the packaged embeddings.

metric.description: Required similarity metric label for the packaged embeddings.

normalized.description: Required flag indicating whether the packaged vectors are already normalized.

vectors_path.description: Required relative path to the packaged raw vector payload.

vector_count.description: Optional build-derived number of vectors in the packaged embedding payload.

vectors_hash.description: Optional build-derived hash of the packaged vector payload.

id.description: Required index identifier, typically matching the default packaged retrieval index.

type.description: Required index type label for the packaged retrieval index.

path.description: Required relative path to the packaged local retrieval index directory or file.

embedding_id.description: Required embedding identifier that this index was built against.

generated_by.description: Optional generator label recorded for provenance, such as agentpm knowledge build.

strategy.description: Optional open-ended retrieval strategy label, such as full_context, vector, or future hybrid variants.

default_top_k.description: Optional default result count to use during vector retrieval.

default_score_threshold.description: Optional score threshold hint for retrieval filtering.

return_citations.description: Optional flag indicating whether retrieval consumers should return citations by default.

sources_manifest_path.description: Optional relative path to a detailed provenance or sources manifest packaged with the Knowledge artifact.

generated_at.description: Optional timestamp indicating when the Knowledge artifact metadata was generated.

builder.description: Optional builder metadata describing the process or tool that generated the packaged Knowledge metadata.

mode.description: Required Knowledge artifact mode. Use context for direct-context document bundles and vector for prepared retrieval corpora.

content_type.description: Optional high-level content classification for the Knowledge artifact, such as documentation or policy.

language.description: Optional primary language label for the packaged content.

documents.description: Declared documents packaged for direct context loading in context mode.

context.description: Optional build-derived aggregate metadata for context-mode documents.

corpus.description: Vector-mode corpus metadata describing packaged chunks and sources.

chunking.description: Optional descriptive metadata about how the vector corpus was chunked.

embedding.description: Vector-mode embedding metadata describing the packaged vectors.

indexes.description: Optional packaged retrieval indexes associated with the vector corpus.

retrieval.description: Optional retrieval defaults or strategy hints for consumers of the Knowledge artifact.

provenance.description: Optional provenance metadata describing how the Knowledge artifact was generated.

read.description: Optional Loop-authored intent for whether Memory reads are permitted in this phase.

write.description: Optional Loop-authored intent for whether Memory writes are permitted in this phase.

tools.description: Optional Loop-authored intent for whether Tool use is permitted in this phase.

knowledge.description: Optional Loop-authored intent for whether Knowledge use is permitted in this phase.

memory.description: Optional Loop-authored intent for whether Memory reads and writes are permitted in this phase.

id.description: Required stable identifier for the authored phase outcome.

description.description: Required human-readable description of what the outcome means.

objective.description: Required human-readable objective describing what this phase is intended to accomplish.

access.description: Optional declarative access-intent metadata for this phase.

outcomes.description: Optional explicit authored outcomes for this phase. When omitted, the phase uses an implicit `complete` outcome.

on.description: Required outcome identifier for the source phase.

to.description: Required target phase identifier or standardized terminal target.

max_steps.description: Optional maximum number of Loop phase executions a compatible runtime may allow.

id.description: Required stable identifier for the declared checkpoint.

type.description: Required checkpoint type. approval is the only supported checkpoint type in this contract.

before_phase.description: Required phase identifier before which approval should be requested.

on_reject.description: Required phase identifier or terminal target to transfer control to when approval is rejected.

max_retries.description: Required positive retry count when tool failure handling uses retry.

on_exhausted.description: Required resolution path when retries are exhausted.

action.description: Required direct tool failure policy action when retries are not used.

archetype.description: Optional open-ended descriptive label for the authored orchestration style.

entry_phase.description: Required phase identifier that names the graph entry point.

error_policy.description: Optional Tool and phase failure handling metadata.

package.description: Required versionless Memory Blueprint package identity.

spaces.description: Optional unique Memory space identifiers associated with this binding.

operations.description: Optional unique Memory operation identifiers associated with this binding.

tools.description: Optional versionless Tool package identities associated with this binding scope.

skills.description: Optional versionless Skill package identities associated with this binding scope.

knowledge.description: Optional versionless Knowledge package identities associated with this binding scope.

memory.description: Optional Memory binding metadata associated with this binding scope.

profiles.description: Optional versionless Instruction Profile package identities associated with this binding scope.

id.description: Required stable identifier for the named MCP surface.

tools.description: Required non-empty unique versionless Tool package identities exposed through this MCP surface.

file.description: Required safe relative path to the consumer-owned context file.

phases.description: Optional phase-scoped authored package bindings keyed by authored Loop phase identifier.

mcp.description: Optional named MCP surfaces for bound Tool packages.

files_root.description: Relative directory inside the template artifact that is copied into the generated project. Template text rendering uses {{ variable_name }} placeholders.

variables.description: Generation-time scaffold variables only. Do not use for API keys, tokens, passwords, or runtime secrets.

stableKebabId.description: Stable lowercase kebab-case identifier used by Loop phases, outcomes, checkpoints, MCP surfaces, and Profile constraints.

profileConstraintId.description: Stable lowercase kebab-case identifier for a declared Instruction Profile constraint.

profileIdentity.description: Required role-level identity metadata for an Instruction Profile.

role.description: Required role the agent should adopt when this Instruction Profile is selected by a consuming runtime.

description.description: Optional additional description of the role and what it represents.

expertise.description: Optional unique authored areas of familiarity or perspective for the role.

profileAudience.description: Optional audience metadata describing who the Instruction Profile is intended to interact with.

description.description: Optional high-level description of the intended audience.

assumed_knowledge.description: Optional description of the baseline knowledge the audience is assumed to have.

adaptation.description: Optional unique authored guidance for how communication should adapt to the audience.

profileVocabulary.description: Optional vocabulary guidance for preferred and avoided wording.

prefer.description: Optional unique terms or phrases the authored behavior prefers to use.

avoid.description: Optional unique terms or phrases the authored behavior prefers to avoid.

profileCommunication.description: Required communication guidance describing how the agent should speak and present information.

tone.description: Required unique open-ended tone labels for the Instruction Profile.

verbosity.description: Required closed verbosity hint for the authored communication style.

guidelines.description: Optional unique authored communication guidelines that should generally apply across responses.

formatting.description: Optional unique authored formatting guidance for how responses should be structured.

vocabulary.description: Optional preferred and avoided vocabulary guidance.

profileConstraint.description: Optional declared behavioral constraint associated with an Instruction Profile.

id.description: Required stable identifier for the declared constraint.

strength.description: Required author-intent strength label for the declared constraint.

instruction.description: Required behavioral instruction expressed by the declared constraint.

profileCapabilityHints.description: Optional advisory capability hints describing what a consuming runtime may need or benefit from.

tool_use.description: Optional advisory flag describing whether tool use is required or recommended.

structured_output.description: Optional advisory flag describing whether structured output is required or recommended.

multimodal_input.description: Optional advisory flag describing whether multimodal input is required or recommended.

profileCompatibility.description: Optional vendor-neutral compatibility hints for consumers of the Instruction Profile.

minimum_context_tokens.description: Optional advisory minimum context-window size the authored behavior expects to work comfortably with.

requires.description: Optional capability hints the author considers required for best use of the profile.

recommends.description: Optional capability hints the author considers beneficial but not strictly required.

profileMetadata.description: Structured Instruction Profile metadata describing role, priorities, communication posture, boundaries, and advisory constraints.

identity.description: Required role-level identity the profile defines.

objectives.description: Required unique durable outcomes the role should generally prioritize across tasks.

principles.description: Optional unique general decision-making principles that should apply across tasks.

audience.description: Optional audience metadata describing who this profile is intended to interact with.

communication.description: Required communication posture for the authored behavior.

boundaries.description: Optional unique authority, representation, or capability boundaries the role should not overstep.

constraints.description: Optional declared behavioral constraints expressing required or preferred author intent.

compatibility.description: Optional advisory compatibility metadata for consumers.

command.description: Bare interpreter name or absolute path to it.

spdx.description: SPDX identifier or expression (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0, MIT OR Apache-2.0)
